name: wpmcp/standard-tools
description: Toolchain for `composer standard` (docs/CODING-STANDARD.md), kept out of the root composer.lock so a slow phpstan/phpstan download never blocks an install. PHPStan itself is the pinned phar bin/standard.sh caches (phpstan/phpstan is replaced here); this project brings the PHPStan extensions, the WordPress stubs and the slevomat sniffs.
